How shoe size conversion is calculated

Convert a shoe size between selected US men’s, US women’s, UK, and EU scales using a practical chart-based approximation. Manufacturers vary in last shape and labeling, so use the brand’s own chart and foot length for a purchase decision. A US men’s size 9 is commonly near UK 8 and EU 42, with brand variation. The calculation validates each input and keeps its stated units explicit. No. The mappings are approximate and brand-specific fits vary. This is an estimate for the stated assumptions; confirm measurements and any applicable professional or local standards before relying on it.

Frequently asked questions

Are size scales exact?

No. The mappings are approximate and brand-specific fits vary.

Should I measure foot length?

Yes. Measure both feet while standing and compare with the manufacturer’s sizing guide.
